records.title: Hodge Conjecture

pairs.reason: The record asks that every rational Hodge class on every smooth complex projective variety be algebraic. Family 032 proves the rational Hodge conjecture for every complex CM abelian variety in every dimension and codimension (its further bullets treat abelian and K3 self-powers), a named special class.

records.title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture

pairs.reason: The record asks BSD (rank equality and leading-term formula) for every elliptic curve over Q. Family 002 proves the full BSD formula for every E/Q whose full q-power Selmer group has corank zero or one for some prime q, including finiteness of Sha; this is a restricted class of curves over Q.

Family 004 contains a pointwise 2-converse: for E/Q with nonzero rational 2-torsion whose 2-infinity Selmer corank is zero or one, the analytic and Mordell-Weil ranks equal that corank and Sha is finite. This settles BSD rank equality for a subclass of E/Q, not all of them.

Family 006 proves Goldfeld's density statements for quadratic twists of every E/Q (analytic ranks 0 and 1 each have density 1/2; the mean analytic rank tends to 1/2), which are not BSD for any single curve. The summary of family 002 says that combined with 002 they give full BSD for a density-one set of quadratic twists of each E/Q, a subclass of the record.

records.title: Secret key from all entangled states

Family 272 constructs an entangled state on C^10 x C^10 with zero distillable secret key for protocols that process all copies jointly with unlimited two-way public communication and an eavesdropper holding the purification, a counterexample.

records.title: Kaplansky's Idempotent Conjecture

pairs.reason: The record is universal over fields of every characteristic and torsion-free G. If ab = 1 and ba != 1 in K[G], then e = ba is idempotent ((ba)(ba) = b(ab)a = ba), e != 1 by hypothesis, and e != 0 since a = (ab)a = a(ba). So family 197's October-4 manuscript -- a finitely presented TORSION-FREE group with F_2[G] not directly finite -- would give a nontrivial idempotent in F_2[G]. PAPER_ONLY: the formalized direct-finiteness counterexample is for a group WITH torsion (odd prime order), which does not touch this record. Read with family 207 (SUBCASE, FORMAL): the characteristic-zero half is claimed proved. Net claimed state: true in characteristic 0, false in characteristic 2.

Record asks that every idempotent of K[G] is 0 or 1 for every field K of any characteristic and every torsion-free G. Family 207 proves this for every torsion-free group and every commutative unital characteristic-zero domain (so all characteristic-zero fields), leaving positive characteristic open.

records.title: Unrestricted Linear-Circuit Lower Bound for the Discrete Fourier Transform

pairs.reason: Record asserts C_DFT(n) >= c n log n for all large n in the model where each step forms lambda f + mu g. Family 130's later version gives exact DFT circuits of size o(n log n) along an unbounded sequence of lengths, counting every addition, subtraction and scalar multiplication, which refutes the uniform lower bound.

records.title: Griffiths Positivity Conjecture for Ample Vector Bundles

pairs.reason: Record asks a smooth strictly Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric on every ample holomorphic vector bundle. Family 050 constructs ample rank-two bundles on P^1 x P^1 (coordinatewise power pullbacks tensored with O(1,1)) that admit no such metric for all sufficiently large powers, a counterexample.

records.title: Alperins Weight Conjecture for Modular Representations of Finite Groups

pairs.reason: Record asks that each p-block B of a finite group has as many simple modules as there are G-conjugacy classes of B-weights. Family 202 proves the numerical blockwise Alperin weight conjecture for every prime and finite group: the number of irreducible Brauer characters in a block equals the number of conjugacy classes of its weights.

records.title: Birkhoff Conjecture (Near-Boundary Continuous Invariant Foliation)

pairs.reason: Record asks that a smooth strictly convex positive-curvature planar billiard whose grazing annulus is foliated by continuous T-invariant essential curves be an ellipse, circles included. Family 147 proves that a continuous foliation of a full grazing annulus by individually invariant essential curves forces the boundary to be an ellipse, which is the invariant-curve formulation the record selects.

records.title: Finiteness of Finitely Presented Periodic Groups

pairs.reason: Record asks whether every finitely presented group in which every element has finite order is finite. Family 247 constructs an infinite finitely presented periodic group (every element of finite order), so the statement fails.

records.title: Hopf Conjecture: no metric of positive sectional curvature on S^2 x S^2

pairs.reason: Record asks whether S^2 x S^2 admits a metric of positive sectional curvature (Hopf). Family 348 classifies closed Einstein four-manifolds with positive sectional curvature (up to scaling S^4, CP^2, RP^4), which excludes S^2 x S^2 among Einstein metrics; it says nothing about non-Einstein metrics, so it is a special case only.

records.title: Amenability of Thompson's Group F

pairs.reason: Record asks whether Thompson's group F of dyadic piecewise-linear homeomorphisms of [0,1] is amenable. Family 248 proves F is nonamenable, which answers the question negatively.

records.title: Sinai's Positive Metric Entropy Conjecture for the Chirikov Standard Map

pairs.reason: Record asks for a positive-Lebesgue-measure set of parameters k at which f_k(x,y)=(x+y+k sin 2pi x, y+k sin 2pi x) mod Z^2 has positive metric entropy. Family 146 proves positive metric entropy for the standard sine map at every sufficiently large parameter, a full tail that contains such a positive-measure set.

records.title: Zariski Multiplicity Conjecture for Hypersurface Singularities

pairs.reason: Record asks whether ambient topological equivalence of reduced hypersurface germs in C^n forces equal multiplicity. Family 059 constructs ambiently homeomorphic reduced hypersurface germs of multiplicities 2 and 3 (in a space of dimension divisible by 8) and of multiplicities 4 and 5 in C^4, which refutes the universal statement.

records.title: Log-Brunn-Minkowski Inequality for Symmetric Convex Bodies

pairs.reason: Record asks for |(1-lambda)K +_0 lambda L| >= |K|^(1-lambda) |L|^lambda for origin-symmetric convex bodies K, L and lambda in [0,1]. Family 091 proves the logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality for arbitrary origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension.

records.title: Calderón uniqueness for bounded measurable real isotropic conductivities

pairs.reason: Record asks whether equal full weak Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps of bounded measurable real scalar conductivities (uniformly positive and bounded) on bounded connected Lipschitz domains in every R^n, n>=3, force equal conductivities. Family 365 (bullet dated 23 Sep 2026) constructs two distinct uniformly positive bounded measurable conductivities on a ball in R^3 with the same full DN operator, a counterexample at n=3; the record's status calls this endpoint open, so the family's date is a point for the reviewer to check.

records.title: Koebe circle-domain uniformization conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks that every nonempty connected open domain of the Riemann sphere be conformally homeomorphic to a circle domain (complementary components round disks or points). Family 071 proves that every domain in the Riemann sphere is conformally equivalent to a circle domain, resolving Koebe's conjecture positively.

records.title: Benjamini-Schramm conjecture p_c<p_u for non-amenable Cayley graphs

pairs.reason: Record asks for p_c < p_u if and only if the group is nonamenable, for Cayley graphs of finitely generated infinite groups. Family 214 proves only the 'if' direction (nonamenable quasi-transitive graphs have p_c < p_u); the converse (amenable implies p_c = p_u) is not claimed.

records.title: Nagata Conjecture on Plane Curve Linear Systems

pairs.reason: Record asks that every plane curve of degree d with multiplicities at least m_i at r >= 10 very general points satisfy d > (1/sqrt r) sum m_i. Family 039 proves the equivalent strict inequality sum m_i < d sqrt(r) for every nonzero effective plane curve through r >= 10 very general points, with arbitrary multiplicities.

records.title: Fujita Freeness Conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks that K_X+(n+1)L be basepoint-free for smooth projective X of dimension n and ample L. Family 038 proves Fujita's freeness conjecture: K_X+mL is globally generated for every m >= n+1, which implies basepoint-freeness.

records.title: Serres Positivity Conjecture for Intersection Multiplicities over Regular Local Rings

pairs.reason: Record asks that chi^R(M,N) be strictly positive whenever M tensor N has finite length and dim M + dim N = dim R over a regular local ring. Family 193 proves this, including ramified mixed characteristic, for nonzero finitely generated modules, the implicit nonvanishing hypothesis of the record.

records.title: Dixmier unitarisability problem for discrete groups

pairs.reason: Record asks that every unitarisable discrete group (every uniformly bounded representation on any Hilbert space similar to unitary) be amenable. Family 251 proves that a discrete group is amenable if and only if every uniformly bounded representation on a complex Hilbert space is similar to a unitary, which contains the required direction for arbitrary Hilbert spaces.

records.title: Kobayashi Conjecture: Hyperbolic Compact Kähler Manifolds Have Ample Canonical Bundle

pairs.reason: Record asks that a compact connected Kähler manifold that is Kobayashi hyperbolic (every holomorphic map from C is constant) have ample canonical bundle. Family 051 proves that every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive dimension with no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle.

records.title: Toms–Winter: Strict Comparison Implies Z-Stability

pairs.reason: The record asks strict comparison => Z-stability for separable simple nuclear non-elementary C*-algebras, 'unital or nonunital'. Family 291 claims the UNITAL Toms-Winter conjecture (strict comparison <=> finite nuclear dimension <=> Z-stability) and only stated nonunital classes; the agent's SAME_TARGET is downgraded because the record explicitly includes the nonunital case. The scope note covers Jiang-Su absorption for unital algebras with strict comparison.

Record asks for strict comparison implies Z-stability for all simple separable nuclear non-elementary C*-algebras. Family 302 treats the special class C(X) crossed by Z for minimal homeomorphisms of infinite compact metrizable spaces, proving radius of comparison = mean dimension / 2, so in that class the comparison property corresponds to zero mean dimension, which the family equates with Jiang-Su stability.

records.title: Shelah's Categoricity Conjecture for L_omega1,omega

pairs.reason: Record asks whether categoricity in one cardinal at or above the L_{omega1,omega} Hanf threshold transfers to all such cardinals. Family 240 proves a ZFC eventual-categoricity theorem for AECs with a uniform threshold depending only on the Lowenheim-Skolem number, a weaker form of transfer that would cover L_{omega1,omega} classes if they are AECs of LS number aleph_0 (reviewer to confirm); it does not identify the threshold with the record's delta_omega1, and its CH counterexample concerns a different threshold for AECs.

records.title: LeBrun-Salamon Conjecture: positive quaternion-Kahler manifolds are symmetric spaces

pairs.reason: Record asks that every compact positive quaternion-Kahler manifold with holonomy in Sp(n)Sp(1) be symmetric. Family 062 proves the LeBrun-Salamon conjecture: every closed connected positive quaternion-Kahler manifold of real dimension at least eight is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space; the reviewer must check the dimension-4 case, which the family's statement does not cover.

records.title: Separable Quotient Problem for Banach Spaces

pairs.reason: 'Prove or disprove' is answered by neither: family 323 claims the separable quotient problem is independent of ZFC relative to a measurable cardinal (true in some models, false under CH). FORMAL_WEAKER: the Lean statement is the CH counterexample direction only; the consistency of the positive answer is paper-only.

records.title: Hyperkähler SYZ (Lagrangian Fibration) Conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks that every nontrivial nef line bundle L on a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifold with q(c1(L))=0 have a globally generated positive tensor power. Family 041 proves the strong hyperkahler SYZ conjecture: every holomorphic line bundle with nonzero nef isotropic first Chern class is semiample; the record's 'nontrivial' must mean nonzero class, as the family reads it.

records.title: Combinatorial Invariance of Kazhdan-Lusztig Polynomials

pairs.reason: Record asks that a directed-graph isomorphism between Bruhat intervals in Coxeter systems force equal Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials. Family 168 proves that an isomorphism of Bruhat intervals in arbitrary Coxeter systems preserves equal-parameter KL polynomials; a directed Bruhat-graph isomorphism of intervals preserves reachability, which is the Bruhat order, so it is an order isomorphism and falls under the family's statement.

records.title: Rokhlin problem on multiple mixing

pairs.reason: Record asks whether mixing of one invertible probability-preserving T forces k-fold mixing for every k>=3, with correlations converging to products as the successive gaps go to infinity. Family 145 claims every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation is mixing of every finite order, with correlations of any finite family of sets converging to the product whenever all pairwise time separations diverge.

records.title: Strong Hyperplane Conjecture for Isotropic Constants

pairs.reason: Record asks for L_K <= L_{Delta_n} for every convex body K in every dimension, i.e. the simplex maximizes the isotropic constant. Family 101 claims simplices uniquely maximize the isotropic constant among convex bodies in every dimension (the strong isotropic constant conjecture), which covers the record's inequality.

records.title: Long-Time Existence of the Calabi Flow on Compact Kaehler Manifolds

pairs.reason: Record asks that Calabi flow from every smooth Kahler metric in a Kahler class containing a cscK metric exists for all time and converges to cscK. Family 352 constructs a smooth U(10)-invariant Kahler metric in the Fubini-Study class of CP^10 whose Calabi flow develops unbounded scalar curvature in finite time, a counterexample to the universal claim.

records.title: Margulis–Platonov normal-subgroup conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks that for an absolutely almost simple simply connected G over a number field K, every noncentral normal subgroup of G(K) is delta^{-1}(W) for an open normal W in the product over rank-zero places. Family 018 claims the Margulis-Platonov conjecture over number fields (and all global fields): every noncentral normal subgroup is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup of the product of anisotropic nonarchimedean local groups.

records.title: GNRS Conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks for bounded multicommodity flow-cut gap (equivalently L1 distortion) for every nontrivial minor-closed family (GNRS). Family 089 proves universal L1 distortion for shortest-path metrics of planar graphs and distortion depending only on treewidth for bounded-treewidth graphs; these are two minor-closed families, not all of them.

records.title: Irrationality of Catalan's Constant

pairs.reason: Record asks to prove or disprove that Catalan's constant G = sum (-1)^n/(2n+1)^2 is irrational. Family 005 proves exactly that G is irrational.

records.title: Zariski Cancellation Problem (characteristic zero, dimension ≥ 3)

pairs.reason: Record asks whether, for every characteristic-zero field k and n>=3, B[X] isomorphic to k[X_1..X_{n+1}] forces B isomorphic to k[X_1..X_n]. Family 047 gives an integral complex affine fourfold X, not isomorphic to A^4, with X x A^1 isomorphic to A^5; this refutes cancellation over C at n=4 and so refutes the universal claim.

records.title: Absolute continuity of Bernoulli convolutions outside reciprocal Pisot parameters

pairs.reason: Record asks whether nu_lambda is absolutely continuous for every lambda in (1/2,1) whose reciprocal is not Pisot. Family 153 proves singularity of unbiased Bernoulli convolutions at the reciprocal of every quartic Salem number in (1,2); these reciprocals lie in (1/2,1), are non-Pisot, and give singular nu_lambda, a counterexample.

records.title: Measure-zero singular set of stationary integral varifolds

pairs.reason: Record asks that for every stationary integral m-varifold in an open subset of R^{m+n}, H^m(Sing V)=0. Family 346 proves the singular set of every stationary integral m-varifold in a Euclidean open set has Hausdorff dimension at most m-1, which implies H^m(Sing V)=0.

records.title: Maximal Number of Mutually Unbiased Bases in Composite Dimensions

pairs.reason: Record asks for the maximal number K of MUBs in non-prime-power composite dimensions, in particular whether K=7 in dimension D=6. Family 266 claims N(6)=3, so seven MUBs do not exist in dimension six; this settles the named D=6 case but not the general composite-dimension question.

records.title: Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture

pairs.reason: Gottschalk: family 197's companion examples give an injective non-surjective cellular automaton (finite alphabet K, the same a,b in K[G]). PAPER_ONLY for the CA claim; the formalized object is the direct-finiteness counterexample over a finite field of characteristic two, from which non-surjunctivity is the paper's derivation.

records.title: Katok entropy rigidity conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks whether, for every closed negatively curved Riemannian manifold, Liouville entropy equals topological entropy iff the metric is locally symmetric. Family 339 proves this for closed manifolds of dimension at least three; the two-dimensional case is outside the family's stated scope.

records.title: Stein's Conjecture on the Hilbert Transform along Lipschitz Vector Fields

pairs.reason: Record asks for an epsilon depending only on the natural Lipschitz scale of v such that the truncated Hilbert transform H_{v,epsilon} is bounded on L^2(R^2). Family 083 proves a uniform L^2 bound for the planar Hilbert transform along any Lipschitz unit vector field with integration length at most an absolute multiple of the reciprocal Lipschitz constant, yielding an L^2-bounded principal-value operator.

records.title: Kaplansky's Direct Finiteness Conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks whether ab=1 implies ba=1 in K[G] for every group G and every field K. Family 197 gives a field K of characteristic two, a finitely presented group G and finite sums a,b in K[G] with ab=1 but ba not 1, a counterexample to the universal statement.

records.title: Small Cohen-Macaulay Conjecture

pairs.reason: Family 195 claims a three-dimensional complete Noetherian normal local domain over C with no nonzero finitely generated MCM module, refuting the record's universal statement. PAPER_ONLY: the Lean file verifies only that the candidate ring exists with the stated properties, not that it lacks a small MCM module.

records.title: Ergodicity of Irrational Triangular Billiards

pairs.reason: Record asks whether every triangular billiard with irrational angles is ergodic for the billiard flow. Family 150 proves the unit-speed billiard flow in every nondegenerate triangle with at least one irrational angle is ergodic (and claims weak mixing) for normalized Liouville measure; the family's 'at least one irrational angle' is the standard meaning of an irrational triangle, which reviewers should confirm matches the record's reading.

records.title: Balanced L4 boundedness of the trilinear Hilbert transform

pairs.reason: Record asks for an L^4 x L^4 x L^4 -> L^{4/3} bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform with slopes 1, 2, 3, and its status says no affirmative boundedness range is known for this operator. Family 086 claims the same slopes-(1,2,3) operator is bounded from L^3 x L^3 x L^3 to L^1; this is a different exponent point, so it does not settle the L^4 target, but it bears on the status statement and deserves human review.

records.title: Campana-Peternell Conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks whether every smooth complex projective Fano manifold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous, in every dimension. Family 067 proves this only in complex dimension six.

records.title: Maximum Number of k-sets and Complexity of k-levels

pairs.reason: Record asks for the maximum number of k-sets of n planar points (equivalently the maximum k-level complexity). Family 183 improves upper bounds on the same quantity for sets with no three collinear: a power saving over the classical O(n^{4/3}) halving-line bound and O(n(k+1)^{1/3-eps0}) strictly separable k-subsets; it does not settle the exact maximum. The record text states no classical bound, so a reviewer may downgrade this to ADJACENT.

records.title: Shub entropy conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks whether h(f) >= log of the spectral radius of f_* on total real homology for every C1 self-map of a compact smooth manifold (Shub). Family 151 constructs a noninvertible C1 self-map with zero topological entropy and eigenvalue 2 on second real homology, so h(f)=0 < log 2, a counterexample.

records.title: Lück's Determinant Conjecture for Discrete Groups

pairs.reason: Record is Lück's determinant conjecture: the integral of log t against the spectral measure of A*A is nonnegative for every A in M_n(Z[G]) and every discrete group G. Family 197 claims a finitely generated group and a square matrix over Z[G], invertible over Q[G], whose Fuglede-Kadison determinant lies strictly between 0 and 1, i.e. the integral is negative. Reviewers should check the group is non-sofic, since the record's status says the sofic case is known.

records.title: Deligne–Drinfeld Freeness Conjecture for grt_1

pairs.reason: Record asks whether grt_1 over Q is freely generated by one generator in each odd weight >=3, with the corresponding isomorphism after weight completion. Family 008 claims the rational Grothendieck-Teichmuller Lie algebra with the Ihara bracket is freely generated by one element in each odd weight >=3, with the isomorphism after weight completion; the family calls the object the GRT Lie algebra, identified here with grt_1.

records.title: Quillen's Conjecture on Posets of Elementary Abelian p-Subgroups

pairs.reason: Record asks that if the poset A_p(G) of nontrivial elementary abelian p-subgroups is contractible then O_p(G) is not 1 (Quillen). Family 310 proves that if O_p(G) is trivial then A_p(G) has nonzero augmented reduced rational homology and so is not contractible, which is the contrapositive of the record's implication for every finite group and prime.

records.title: Deterministic polynomial-time factorization of dense polynomials in F_q[x]

pairs.reason: Record asks for a deterministic algorithm factoring degree-n polynomials over every finite field F_q in time polynomial in n and log q. Family 142 gives a deterministic polynomial-time complete factorization over prime fields F_p with p supplied in binary, i.e. only the case q = p prime.

records.title: David–Semmes Riesz-transform problem in intermediate dimensions

pairs.reason: Record asks whether, for 2 <= n <= d-2 and an n-Ahlfors-David regular Radon measure on R^d, uniform L^2 boundedness of the truncated n-dimensional Riesz transforms forces uniform n-rectifiability. Family 081 proves exactly this for integers d >= 4 and 2 <= n <= d-2 under uniform L^2 bounds over all positive hard truncations.

records.title: Smooth Realization of Finite-Entropy Ergodic Transformations

pairs.reason: Record asks whether every ergodic invertible transformation with finite Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy is measurably isomorphic to a C-infinity diffeomorphism of some compact manifold preserving a smooth volume form. Family 152 constructs an ergodic invertible transformation of zero (hence finite) entropy with no such model on any compact finite-dimensional manifold, a counterexample.

records.title: Zariski-Lipman Conjecture

pairs.reason: Record asks whether every complex algebraic variety or complex space with locally free tangent sheaf is smooth. Family 048 constructs a singular normal affine complex surface whose tangent sheaf is free of rank two, a counterexample.

records.title: Persistence Conjecture for Weakly Reversible Mass-Action Systems

pairs.reason: Record asks whether every positive trajectory of a weakly reversible mass-action system whose stoichiometric compatibility class is bounded is persistent. Family 149 proves the permanence conjecture for every positive stoichiometric class, including unbounded ones, via a common absorbing set, which covers the record's bounded case.

records.title: Furstenberg No-Bigeodesics (Planar FPP, Standard Minimum Moment)

pairs.reason: Record asks whether, for every non-atomic edge law G with E[min(t1,...,t4)^2] finite, planar first-passage percolation almost surely has no doubly infinite geodesic (standard minimum-moment version). Family 212 proves almost-sure absence of doubly infinite geodesics for iid nonnegative nonatomic weights under exactly this finite-second-moment-of-the-minimum-of-four condition.
